# Policy differences at the level of the seed

**Generated by `scripts/seed_level_statistics.py` from `comparison.csv`. Do not edit by hand.**

Unit of analysis: the seed (20 per multiplier). For each policy, multiplier and seed the six buffer settings are averaged into one value; each row below compares two policies on those paired values. `better / worse / tied` counts seeds on which the first policy was lower / higher / equal. p-values are exact two-sided sign and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests; **Holm** adjusts the Wilcoxon p-value over every row of the same measure. Policy codes: `0` oracle (nobody waits), `3A` first-come-first-served, `3B` priority matrix, `3C` gate + score, `3D` gate + CP-SAT.
